map.绿地率计算 使用指南: Green Space Ratio Calculator User Guide
map.输入各类绿地面积、规划用地总面积与居住人口，计算绿地率与绿化覆盖率，并对照居住区: Enter the areas of each type of green space, the total planned site area and the resident population, compute the green space ratio and green coverage ratio, and check against residential district or urban planning standards, for project indicator submission.
map.居住区/小区规划报批，需核算绿地率 = 绿地面积 ÷ 总用地面积，判断是否达到规: For residential district or estate planning approval, the green space ratio = green area / total site area must be computed to check whether it meets the code minimum (usually >= 30% for new residential areas).
map.区分\"绿地率\"与\"绿化覆盖率\"：覆盖率还计入树冠投影、架空绿化等，数值一: Distinguish 'green space ratio' from 'green coverage ratio': the coverage ratio also counts tree canopy projection and overhead planting, so it is usually higher than the green space ratio.
map.计算人均绿地 = 绿地面积 ÷ 居住人口，对照人均标准（如新区 ≥ 人均若干 m: Compute green space per capita = green area / resident population, and compare against the per-capita standard (for example, new districts require at least so many m2 per person).
map.绿地率和绿化覆盖率有什么区别？: What is the difference between green space ratio and green coverage ratio?
map.绿地率只计算符合定义的绿地面积（草坪、灌木、乔木投影下的绿地等）占用地的比例；绿: The green space ratio only counts green area meeting the definition (lawn, shrub and tree-projection green space and so on) as a share of the site; green coverage ratio also counts tree canopy projection, wall greening and roof greening, so coverage ratio >= green space ratio. Approval uses the green space ratio.
map.绿地率标准一般是多少？: What is the usual green space ratio standard?
map.《城市居住区规划设计标准》GB 50180 对新区建设绿地率要求 ≥30%，旧区: The 'Standard for urban residential area planning and design' GB 50180 requires a green space ratio of >=30% for new districts and >=25% for old district redevelopment, and also sets a lower bound for public green space per capita. Local implementing rules govern in practice.
